market_summary: Porteføljen er næsten fuldt investeret (97.6%) med et stabilt, overvejende BULL-præget billede på tværs af de 14 åbne positioner. NSIS-B.CO sælges efter udløst stop-loss trods intakte fundamentals — lille position, disciplin frem for at chase. DSV.CO holdes trods dagens BEAR-verdict, da hverken Zacks-nedgraderingen eller Schenker-integrationsrisikoen er ny information siden entry. Ingen nye køb i dag: den ledige likviditet efter NSIS-B-salget er beskeden, og de tre resterende BULL-kandidater uden position (BAVA.CO, JYSK.CO, ROCK-B.CO) ville enten øge koncentrationen i den allerede tungeste sektor (Healthcare 21.9%) eller kun give plads til en umaterielt lille position — venter på bedre budget/setup.

decisions.name: ISS
decisions.reasoning: Fortsat stærk organisk vækst (8.9%) og udvidet tilbagekøb opvejer den milde tekniske svaghed under SMA50 — SEC-sagen vedrører en anden, urelateret amerikansk virksomhed. Thesis intakt, ingen stop-nærhed.
bull: +27% earnings growth with 8.9% Q2 organic growth and improving margins, per the H1 call.
Actively expanding buyback program (tranche 2, +DKK 600m), signaling capital-return confidence.
Reasonable valuation at 12.5x forward PE relative to growth.
bear: Price is below SMA50 (-2.2%), a mild near-term technical soft spot despite the longer uptrend.
Facility-services margins remain sensitive to wage inflation and contract-renewal pricing in the current inflation environment.

investment_plan.thesis: Trifecta af katalysatorer (regnskab, udvidet tilbagekøb, oversolgt teknik) fortsætter med at understøtte kursen.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 265. Tag profit nær 320. Revurder hvis regionale udfordringer materialiserer sig i næste regnskab.

decisions.name: Danske Bank
decisions.reasoning: Stabil uptrend nær 52-ugers højeste med reel indtjeningsvækst og rimelig værdiansættelse, men RSI/stokastik nærmer sig overkøbt — begrænset margin of safety for yderligere kortsigtet opside.
bull: Strong uptrend: +16.7% above SMA200, near 52-week highs, with +15.2% earnings growth confirming fundamentals support the move.
Reasonable valuation at 11.5x forward PE with a 4.55% dividend yield despite the rally.
New wealth advisory platform launch signals continued business investment and diversification.
bear: RSI (63) and stochastic (75) are approaching overbought, leaving less room for further near-term upside without a pause.
Momentum has flattened over the last 5 days (+0.67%) after a longer uptrend, which could signal consolidation ahead.

investment_plan.thesis: Sjælden kombination af fundamental og teknisk styrke: opjusteret guidance og aktiv kapitaltilbageførsel i en bekræftet uptrend.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 350. Tag profit nær 400. Revurder ved guidance-nedjustering eller brud i kreditkvaliteten.

decisions.name: Demant
decisions.reasoning: Guidance-opjustering og 15% H1-omsætningsvækst drevet af Oticon Zeal-lanceringen retfærdiggør fortsat uptrend, men det meste af det gode nyt er nu prisfastsat efter +68% fra 52-ugers lavpunkt.
bull: 15% H1 revenue growth with raised full-year guidance, driven by successful product launches (Oticon Zeal).
Strong uptrend, +26% above SMA200, confirming durable fundamental momentum.
The new premium hearing-aid launch (Oticon Zeal) extends the product-cycle tailwind.
bear: No dividend yield and an 18.4x forward PE for the growth rate, near 52-week highs with less margin of safety.
Stock is now 68% above its 52-week low, meaning much of the recovery/re-rating has already happened.

investment_plan.thesis: Guidance-opjustering og nyt produktlanceringsmomentum retfærdiggør indgang trods kortsigtet overkøbt teknik.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 273. Tag profit nær 330. Revurder hvis momentum bryder hurtigt ned uden ny fundamental forklaring.

decisions.name: Pandora
decisions.reasoning: Guidance-opjustering og solid indtjeningsvækst understøtter den etablerede uptrend, men positionen er porteføljens største (11.7%) — holdes uændret uden yderligere tilkøb af hensyn til koncentration.
bull: Q2 guidance was upgraded on 3% organic growth, with +13.6% YoY earnings growth confirming margin execution.
Stock is well above its SMA200 (+29.7%), confirming an intact longer-term uptrend with room toward 52-week highs (-10.6% away).
bear: Organic growth of just 3% is modest for a stock trading at 16.7x forward earnings — the multiple assumes continued margin expansion more than volume growth.
A CFO transition (new CFO replacing the retiring Anders Boyer) introduces near-term leadership/execution uncertainty.

investment_plan.thesis: Momentum-fortsættelse i en fundamentalt understøttet uptrend, men positionen er allerede porteføljens største — koncentrationsrisiko taler imod yderligere tilkøb.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 761. Tag profit nær 910. Revurder ved svagt Q3-regnskab (04/11) eller yderligere deceleration i organisk vækst.

decisions.name: Coloplast
decisions.reasoning: 5-dages faldet på 9.7% ser overdrevet ud mod en 34% fwd-PE-rabat og 82% indtjeningsvækst, men US-refusionsmodvind og Kina-lagerjusteringer fra Q3-callet holder den bredere downtrend intakt. Ingen stop-nærhed.
bull: Forward PE 16.6x is a 34% discount to the Healthcare sector norm, alongside +82% YoY earnings growth.
5.32% dividend yield offers downside cushion while a turnaround plays out.
Stochastic (9) is deeply oversold after a 9.7% five-day selloff, and the Q3 call confirmed organic growth holding at 6%.
bear: US reimbursement headwinds and China inventory adjustments flagged on the Q3 call are structural, not one-off.
Price remains below SMA200 (-5.4%) and -31% from its 52-week high — the broader trend is still down despite the cheap valuation.
A recent management team change (Aug 17) adds near-term execution uncertainty.

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value sundhedsnavn med stærk indtjeningsvækst og solidt udbytte, nedgraderet til neutral konviktion pga. US-refusionsmodvind, Kina-lagerjusteringer og ledelsesskifte.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 419. Tag profit nær 520. Trim hvis US-refusionsmodvinden eskalerer yderligere eller ledelsesskiftet skaber eksekveringsproblemer.

decisions.name: Ørsted
decisions.reasoning: Borkum Riffgrund 3 er nu i drift og en DCF-vurdering peger på markant undervurdering, men et næsten totalt (-95%) å/å indtjeningsfald og fortsat downtrend under begge glidende gennemsnit holder konviktionen neutral.
bull: Borkum Riffgrund 3 (913 MW) offshore wind farm just began commercial operations, adding a new contracted long-term revenue stream.
Independent DCF analysis estimates the stock may be 47% undervalued after the multi-year selloff.
Revenue growth of +20.5% shows the underlying build-out is translating into top-line growth despite reported earnings weakness.
bear: Earnings growth of -94.6% YoY reflects a severe profitability hit (likely impairments/one-offs tied to past project write-downs).
Stock remains below both SMA50 and SMA200, confirming the downtrend from the offshore-wind sector's broader struggles hasn't reversed.
A major shareholder disclosure (Sept 9) adds ownership-structure uncertainty worth monitoring.

investment_plan.thesis: Kontrarisk value-position i en oversolgt aktie efter et regnskab domineret af engangsnedskrivninger, hvor ledelsen fastholder guidance og Hornsea 3 kører efter planen.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 126.51. Tag profit nær 158. Revurder hvis US-regulatorisk/toldrelateret modvind eskalerer, eller hvis nedskrivningerne gentager sig i næste regnskab.

decisions.name: Carlsberg
decisions.reasoning: Guidance-løft og soft-drinks-diversificering (Britvic) understøttes af insiderkøb og en opjusteret analytiker-fair-value, mens kernebierens volumener forbliver bløde — thesis intakt under SMA50.
bull: Guidance was lifted at the lower end, with soft drinks/alcohol-free growing 7.8%, offsetting slight beer volume softness.
An analyst fair-value estimate was recently raised (to ~DKK 1,068), above the current price.
Insider buying by a Supervisory Board member signals confidence.
bear: Price remains below SMA50 (-5.4%), a near-term technical headwind despite being above SMA200.
Core beer volumes are still declining slightly, so growth depends on diversification (Britvic, soft drinks) continuing to deliver.

investment_plan.thesis: Oversolgt value/mean-reversion-indgang i en kvalitets-bryggerivirksomhed med solid indtjeningsvækst og opjusteret fair value.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 842.3 (~2x ATR). Tag profit nær 950 (SMA200-niveau). Revurder hvis downtrenden fortsætter uden stabilisering.

decisions.name: Vestas Wind Systems
decisions.reasoning: Opjusteret EBIT-margin-guidance og 26% omsætningsvækst understøtter den stærke uptrend, men +833%-indtjeningstallet er et lav-base-effekt og teknikken er overkøbt nær 52-ugers højeste — ingen tilkøb.
bull: Full-year EBIT margin guidance was raised after Q2, with 26.1% revenue growth confirming order-book execution.
An independent DCF estimate points to ~23.4% further upside even after the stock's strong one-year return.
An active share buyback plus inclusion on “stocks worth adding” lists for wind-capacity exposure reflect broad positive sentiment.
bear: Reported earnings growth of +833% is coming off a very depressed prior-year base — the growth rate overstates the improvement in absolute profitability.
At 17.1x forward earnings near 52-week highs (-4%), much of the turnaround is already reflected in the price.

investment_plan.thesis: Fundamental guidance-opjustering i en tidligere succesfuld turnaround-setup. Teknikken er stærkt overkøbt efter rallyet, så positionen holdes uændret indtil en afkøling eller ny bekræftelse.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 197.02 (~2x ATR). Tag profit nær 235. Revurder hvis rallyet vender skarpt uden ny fundamental bekræftelse.

decisions.name: Novonesis
decisions.reasoning: Stop-loss udløst (424.5 < 427.4). Fundamentals (opjusteret guidance, buyback, +26.7% indtjeningsvækst) er intakte, men vi respekterer den mekaniske risikodisciplin frem for at chase en lille, dyrt prissat (23.8x fwd PE) position gennem et brudt stop.
bull: An increased full-year 2026 outlook plus a new share buyback program announced in August signal management confidence.
+26.7% earnings growth with stochastic at just 3.6 — a sharply oversold reading after a 6.8% five-day drop, setting up a mean-reversion opportunity.
bear: Forward PE of 23.8x is still rich for the specialty-chemicals/biosolutions sector, leaving less margin for error if growth decelerates.
The 5-day selloff (-6.8%) reversing a positive 20-day trend (+2.55%) shows momentum has turned negative very recently.

investment_plan.thesis: Position lukket pga. udløst stop-loss (~2x ATR under entry). Fundamentals uændrede men teknisk momentum brudt negativt; genovervej senere hvis stabilisering over SMA50 bekræftes.

decisions.name: Royal Unibrew
decisions.reasoning: 35% værdiansættelsesrabat, forbedrede H1-marginer og aktivt tilbagekøb giver en troværdig value-case, men fladt omsætningsvækst og en position tæt på 52-ugers lavpunkt betyder reel downtrend-risiko — tæt overvågning.
bull: Forward PE 11.1x is a 35% discount to the Consumer Defensive sector norm, among the cheapest multiples in the C25 index.
H1 report showed higher profit and improving margins, with own-brand growth offsetting inflation.
An active, recently expanded share buyback (up to DKK 300m) signals management sees value at current levels.
bear: Price sits just 5.6% above its 52-week low — a break below could trigger further technical selling.
Revenue growth is essentially flat (-0.3%), so profit gains are margin-driven rather than volume-driven, a less durable source.
Deep downtrend confirmed: -9% below SMA50, -16% below SMA200.

investment_plan.thesis: Kontrarisk mean-reversion-indgang i en statistisk billig aktie med aktivt tilbagekøb og forbedrede marginer, trods fortsat bekræftet downtrend. Bemærk: samme oversolgt-bounce-thesis mislykkedes tidligere på RBREW (-7.8%, stop ramt) — tæt overvågning er påkrævet.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 409 (~2x ATR). Tag profit nær 480 (SMA50-genvinding). Revurder hvis downtrenden fortsætter uden stabilisering, eller hvis volumenvækst udebliver.

decisions.name: DSV
decisions.reasoning: BEAR-verdict og Zacks 'Bear of the Day' er begge kendt/prissat inden købet (hhv. 4/8 og H1-regnskabet 22/7) — ingen ny materiel forværring siden entry 3/9. Stop ikke udløst, position let i plus, kontrarisk oversolgt-thesis stadig intakt. Holdes, men tæt overvåget.
bull: Revenue growth of +23.7% (Schenker acquisition contribution) with record EBIT reported in H1.
Forward PE of 15.75x is reasonable against that growth, and integration synergies remain a multi-year tailwind.
bear: Zacks flagged DSV as “Bear of the Day,” explicitly noting the near-term investment case has weakened considerably.
Earnings growth is negative (-4%) even as revenue grows — margin/integration costs from Schenker are a real drag right now.
Confirmed downtrend: -8.7% below SMA50, -15.3% below SMA200, -30.6% from its 52-week high.

investment_plan.thesis: Kontrarisk indgang i en kvalitetslogistikaktør efter rekord-EBIT i H1 blev overskygget af DB Schenker-integrationsomkostninger og negativ sentiment. Dybt oversolgt teknik giver attraktiv risk/reward for en mean-reversion mod SMA50.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 1253 (~2x ATR). Tag profit nær 1480 (SMA50-genvinding). Revurder hvis integrationsomkostningerne eskalerer yderligere eller downtrenden accelererer uden stabilisering.

decisions.name: NNIT
decisions.reasoning: 9.8x fwd PE og rapporteret US-margingenopretning er tiltalende, men faldende omsætning og fortsat negativ SMA200-trend betyder at turnaround-historien skal bekræftes i tal før konviktionen kan hæves.
bull: Forward PE of just 9.8x is very cheap in absolute terms, and management highlighted margin recovery in the US segment plus robust Public Denmark growth.
The strategic pivot toward AI platforms could reposition the IT-services business for renewed growth.
bear: Revenue is declining (-6.7% YoY) and earnings-growth data is unavailable, making the “cheap” multiple harder to trust.
Stock remains 36% below its 52-week high and below SMA200, confirming the multi-quarter downtrend hasn't reversed yet.

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value turnaround i en dansk IT-serviceudbyder med tidlige tegn på US-margingenopretning og teknisk basedannelse efter 52-ugers lavpunkt. Moderat sizet grundet endnu ubekræftet omsætningsvending.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 36.79 (~2x ATR). Tag profit nær 47. Revurder hvis omsætningsfaldet accelererer eller transformationsstrategien ikke viser fremgang i næste regnskab.

decisions.name: Ambu
decisions.reasoning: 16% organisk endoskopi-vækst og aktivt tilbagekøb understøtter bull-casen, men aktien er fortsat i en bekræftet downtrend (-41% fra top) med FX/told-modvind — oversolgt RSI/stokastik taler for et taktisk bounce.
bull: 16% organic growth in endoscopy solutions with improving EBIT margin, per the Q3 earnings call.
+28% earnings growth YoY with an active share buyback signaling management confidence.
RSI (32) and stochastic (14) are both oversold after a 41% drawdown from 52-week highs, setting up a technical bounce.
bear: Stock remains in a confirmed downtrend, -7% below SMA50 and -11% below SMA200.
FX and tariff headwinds were explicitly cited as challenges on the earnings call.
The updated 2025/26 financial outlook release creates event risk around whether guidance was raised or cut.

investment_plan.thesis: Kontrarisk value-indgang i en kvalitets-medicoproducent efter et stærkt Q3-regnskab blev overskygget af FX/told-bekymringer og teknisk salgspres — deep-tier oversolgt bounce-setup med solid fundamental understøttelse.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 61.94 (~2x ATR). Tag profit nær 78. Revurder hvis FX/toldmodvinden eskalerer yderligere eller næste regnskab (05/11) viser deceleration i endoskopivæksten.

decisions.name: Nordea Bank
decisions.reasoning: 7.39% dividendeafkast og momentum-status understøtter holdet, men indtjeningsvæksten er aftaget til blot 2.9% mens RSI/stokastik nærmer sig overkøbt — tålmodighed frem for tilkøb på nuværende niveau.
bull: High 7.39% dividend yield with earnings growth still positive offers a compelling income case.
Zacks flagged Nordea as a “great momentum stock,” consistent with price near 52-week highs and above both SMAs.
bear: RSI (67.5) and stochastic (67) are approaching overbought, leaving limited near-term upside room without a pullback.
Earnings growth has slowed to just +2.9% YoY, a much more modest pace than the stock's recent price momentum implies.

investment_plan.thesis: Defensiv dividendebank til erstatning for TRYG — stabil uptrend over begge glidende gennemsnit og 7.3% dividendeafkast giver nedsidedæmpning, mens indtjeningsvæksten er afdæmpet men positiv.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Sælg ved brud under 127.86 (~2x ATR). Tag profit nær 145. Revurder hvis dividenden skæres eller indtjeningsvæksten bliver negativ.
